type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Add self-refutation framework documentation and Lean formalization

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.allOptionalClaimsEnsureSafety
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ∀ sc ∈ s.systemClaims, presentedAsOptional sc = true) : preservesOptionality s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.canonicalExamplesEnsureTestability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (c : LimitCriterion) (h : hasCanonicalExample c) (h2 : c.reproducible = true) : c.isComplete = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.completeCriteriaPreventTypeV
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : allLimitsTestable s) : detectTypeVViolation s = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.conservativityViolationImpliesTypeI
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ¬respectsConservativity s) : ∃ (p : Problem) (r : Response), (p, r) ∈ s.responseHistory.responses ∧ Response.isLimit r ∧ systemStoppedPrematurely p r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.distinctTypesPreserveInfo
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (lt1 lt2 : LimitType) (h : lt1 ≠ lt2) : LimitType.structurallyDistinct lt1 lt2 = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.explicitCostsPreventTypeIII
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : allRegimeSwitchesPayCost s) : detectTypeIIIViolation s = none ∨ ∃ v, detectTypeIIIViolation s = some v ∧ v.severity < 5

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.formalizedRegimePreventsAdHoc
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ∀ rs ∈ s.regimeSwitches, regimeConceptFormalized rs) : allRegimeSwitchesPayCost s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.frameworkOptionality
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : preservesOptionality s → detectTypeIVViolation s = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.granularityImpliesDistinction
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (lc : LimitClassification) (h : maintainsGranularity lc = true) : lc.types.eraseDups.length = lc.types.length

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.highLimitRatioCausesTypeI
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (rh : ResponseHistory) (h : rh.limitRatio > limitRatioThreshold) : ∃ v : Violation, v.violationType = ViolationType.typeI

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.informationLossImpliesTypeII
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ¬providesInformation s) : ∃ (p : Problem) (r : Response), (p, r) ∈ s.responseHistory.responses ∧ match r with | Response.limitInvocation _ c => ¬c.isComplete | _ => False

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.limitExplainsOrRefutes
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (p : Problem) (r : Response) : (p, r) ∈ s.responseHistory.responses → Response.isLimit r → (providesInformation s ∨ detectTypeIIViolation s ≠ none) ∧ (allLimitsTestable s ∨ detectTypeVViolation s ≠ none)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.limitInformativeness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (p : Problem) (lt : LimitType) (c : LimitCriterion) : (p, Response.limitInvocation lt c) ∈ s.responseHistory.responses → c.isComplete → hasCompleteCriteria lt c → detectTypeIIViolation s = none ∧ detectTypeVViolation s = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.metaTotalityAvoided
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : detectTypeIVViolation s = none) : preservesOptionality s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.missingCostsImplyTypeIII
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ¬allRegimeSwitchesPayCost s) : ∃ rs ∈ s.regimeSwitches, ¬rs.hasExplicitCost ∨ ¬isNonTrivialCost rs.cost

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.optionalityPreventsTypeIV
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : preservesOptionality s) : detectTypeIVViolation s = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.regimeCostNonTriviality
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (rs : RegimeSwitch) : rs ∈ s.regimeSwitches → rs.hasExplicitCost → isNonTrivialCost rs.cost → detectTypeIIIViolation s = none ∨ ∃ v, detectTypeIIIViolation s = some v ∧ v.severity < 9

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.regimeFormalizationDecidable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (rs : RegimeSwitch) : (regimeConceptFormalized rs ∨ ¬regimeConceptFormalized rs)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.scientificValidityRequiresTestability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ∀ (p : Problem) (r : Response), (p, r) ∈ s.responseHistory.responses → Response.isLimit r → ∃ c, match r with | Response.limitInvocation _ c => c.reproducible | _ => True) : allLimitsTestable s ∨ detectTypeVViolation s ≠ none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.selfRefutationDecidable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : (s.isConsistent ∨ ¬s.isConsistent)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.systemConsistencyCompleteness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : s.isConsistent ↔ detectTypeIViolation s = none ∧ detectTypeIIViolation s = none ∧ detectTypeIIIViolation s = none ∧ detectTypeIVViolation s = none ∧ detectTypeVViolation s = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.systemConsistentIffNoViolations
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : s.isConsistent ↔ s.violations.isEmpty

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.systemVitalityThroughRefutability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : (∃ v ∈ s.violations, True) ∨ s.isConsistent

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.testabilityRequirement
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : allLimitsTestable s → detectTypeVViolation s = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeIDetectionSound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : isTypeIViolation s = true) : ∃ v : Violation, v.violationType = ViolationType.typeI ∧ detectTypeIViolation s = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeIIDetectionSound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : isTypeIIViolation s = true) : ∃ v : Violation, v.violationType = ViolationType.typeII ∧ detectTypeIIViolation s = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeIIIDetectionSound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : isTypeIIIViolation s = true) : ∃ v : Violation, v.violationType = ViolationType.typeIII ∧ detectTypeIIIViolation s = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeIIPreventedByDiversity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : hasStructuralDistinction s.limitClassification = true) (h2 : maintainsGranularity s.limitClassification = true) : detectTypeIIViolation s = none ∨ ∃ v, detectTypeIIViolation s = some v ∧ v.severity < 5

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeIPreventedByClassicalAttempts
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ∀ (p : Problem) (r : Response), (p, r) ∈ s.responseHistory.responses → Response.isLimit r → Response.attemptedClassical r ∨ p.isDifficult) : detectTypeIViolation s = none ∨ ∃ v, detectTypeIViolation s = some v ∧ v.severity < 5

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeIVDetectionSound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : isTypeIVViolation s = true) : ∃ v : Violation, v.violationType = ViolationType.typeIV ∧ detectTypeIVViolation s = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeIViolationImpliesInconsistency
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (v : Violation) (h : v.violationType = ViolationType.typeI) : ¬(s.addViolation v).isConsistent

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.typeVDetectionSound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : isTypeVViolation s = true) : ∃ v : Violation, v.violationType = ViolationType.typeV ∧ detectTypeVViolation s = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.uniqueCausesImplyTypeIISafety
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : uniqueStructuralCauses s.limitClassification) : providesInformation s ∨ ∃ v, detectTypeIIViolation s = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.universalizingClaimsImplyTypeIV
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ¬preservesOptionality s) : ∃ sc ∈ s.systemClaims, SystemClaim.isUniversalizing sc

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.untestedLimitsImplyTypeV
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) (h : ¬allLimitsTestable s) : ∃ (p : Problem) (lt : LimitType) (c : LimitCriterion), (p, Response.limitInvocation lt c) ∈ s.responseHistory.responses ∧ ¬hasCompleteCriteria lt c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.validateTypeIMaintainsOrIncreases
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : (validateTypeI s).violations.length ≥ s.violations.length

theorems_only_on_branches.name: SelfRefutation.validationMonotonic
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : SystemState) : (validateAll s).violations.length ≥ s.violations.length
